title: Does Not burn to the bottom, Leaves One inch of unburned candle wax .
text:
Does Not burn to the bottom, Leaves One inch of unburned candle wax .. Update,: I will not be buying Meyers candles any longer, as the wick does not burn to the bottom, and leaves almost
One Inch if unburned candle wax ! There is not much wax in this to begin with!
Even though I like the scent I’m lowering this to 2 stars.

description: Sometimes it feels good just to have a nice candle giving off some extra fragrance while you're busy with your chores. A Mrs. Meyer's Clean Day Geranium Candle can help you do exactly that. Let the relaxing, wonderfully soothing floral scent fill your room. Geraniums, so bold & cheery to see, and clearly quite rosy to smell. This soy candle is an easy and elegant protector of any front porch. So nice to have on hand! The cute recyclable glass candle jar makes it a great gift idea as well. All candles are made from vegetable, cottonseed and soy wax. The lead-free cotton candle wick has a 25-hour burn time and provides garden fresh fragrance while you clean or relax at home. Also available in other garden inspired scents and products such as body lotions, laundry detergents, bar soaps, and so much more! Mrs. Meyer's - rooted in goodness.
